comments.value: My situation requires alternative verification methods too or adding more ID to Persona, but Persona relocated my question to VRChat, and VRChat support had an AI generated answer which basically told me nothing can be done, your situation is too unique and there is no solution yet provided, wow. Didn't expect AI assistant to be sorry for my situation instead of an answer with a solution ahahah

Persona is the system I work with almost daily, and it is, unfortunately, far from perfect. There are many factors at play, and it's unlikely that any party will share any reason why some attempts get declined to prevent creating a possible fraud vector.

There is no ideal solution for this as the manual verification is very resource intensive process and requires specialized staff. Other than hiring more people that can actually handle the review process, only other partnered verification platform may provide alternative ways to verify age, but then it's two systems, more quirks and even more vectors.

I'm hoping VRChat team goes the manual review path with actual people making decisions based on objectivity and the situation of the individual user.

Seeing as VRChat's going to be cracking down on things and enforcing age verification a lot more heavily, what's going to be done with cases like this? 

What steps are being taken to improve the age verification process to make sure people can still enjoy VRChat and not get locked out of an event or a group due to a Persona side issue? 

What about people that Persona simply won't take their identification documents (such as overseas) or people that, on some principle or personal standpoint, don't want to give their ID out to a company they have no way of fully trusting with their data?

In light of the announcement by Furality I am revisiting this issue once again.

It has been almost a year since I made this post, since then my concern of gradually being pushed out of the social spaces I frequent has become a reality. More and more communities require age verification in order to join their instances, and I don't see that trend reversing any time soon.

What upsets me is the apparent complete lack of ownership of this issue by anyone with any kind of decision-making capacity. I had hoped that by now someone would have indicated that they were at least aware of us.

> to prevent creating a possible fraud vector

I'm sure I don't have to recite the age-old "security through obscurity is no security at all" adage.

This is the primary reason that digital age verification systems are so problematic. Everyone's so thirsty for the data mining that nobody's bothered to engineer a trustworthy verification scaffold.

For dog's sake, VRChat, there has to be a better way than this.

We need a solution to this problem, immediately. Either instate manual reviews, or have someone from VRChat staff escalate tickets for this to persona directly for solutions.

The fact that many people have been actively having this problem for over 12 months without a single notice of any troubleshooting assistance is running head long into negligent territory.

Will add my 2p on this:

I'm in agreement with Foodman; At minimum we need a proper support pipeline for issues like this.
This needs to be made a high priority due to Furality now requiring age verification. Somebody needs to be able to handle cases like this rather than let them go unanswered for almost a year.

The fact that we are 4 months out from a major event that will require age verification and the implication is that this will be the way forward for similar events in the future...and this year old issue STILL hasn't been addressed is a major indictment against VRChat.

You cannot expect large scale events to adopt this system if these problems are occuring. That is unacceptable in every dimension.

Another update on my situation:

I have finally figured out what is going on with my verification. In my country there are certain laws when it comes to organisations requesting identity documents online. Thus I have been submitting my identity documents in the manner that our regulatory authority recommends.

However, the system VRChat uses appears to require an identity document that is unaltered or at least displays information they are not allowed to process. I have contacted Persona legal about this. They directed me to VRChat legal who have yet to respond to my inquiry.

I know this because it appears that identity documents are stored in a format that can be viewed by employees of Persona for some unknown amount of time if verification doesn’t succeed.

I am disappointed that VRChat has displayed so little urgency in addressing this issue and shocked that personal information is being stored (however briefly) in a manner that is so open to abuse.

details:
The automated system Persona uses fails to identify any form of ID I provide. Despite using every form of ID that’s available to me and trying it under different lighting conditions I get the same result.

This system seems to have no way of falling back on some other form of age verification. The extent of customer support I’ve gotten on this subject so far is being told to try again.

Are there plans to provide alternative methods of age verification so that people don’t get unfairly excluded through no fault of their own?
title: Persona fails to recognise my ID
